archetype: High-Contrast AI SaaS & Tactical Cambodian Omnichannel Commerce
theme_strategy: Dual-Theme (Light & Dark Mode supported via HSL CSS Variables in index.css with crisp surface hierarchy and subtle border contrast)

brand_identity.tagline_khmer: ឆ្លើយតបសារអតិថិជនស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ ២៤/៧ ជាមួយ AI
brand_identity.tagline_english: Omnichannel AI Auto-Reply System for Cambodian Businesses

rules: Headings (H1/H2) must use Outfit with tight letter spacing tracking-tight.
Khmer script text must render smoothly with Noto Sans Khmer and proper line-height leading-relaxed.
Never use Inter for Main or Sub-headings.
Header H1 ceiling is text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl max.
Use bold typography contrast for numbers and KHQR price tags.

dashboard_shell.sidebar: Professional 260px left navigation bar with Replyflow AI brand header, elevated Business Card with mono eyebrow and vibrant initial badge, smooth active nav indicator (primary fill + left glow accent pill), theme toggle, external link button, and logout button with subtle red hover glow. Preserves all data-testids (dash-logo, dash-business-name, nav-inbox, nav-products, nav-orders, nav-settings, nav-channels, nav-billing, nav-businesses, nav-view-site, logout-btn).
dashboard_shell.paused_banner: High-visibility tactical warning banner across top when subscription or reply limit ends. Includes red indicator icon, explicit pause reason text, and direct upgrade link. Preserves data-testid='paused-banner' and 'paused-banner-link'.

inbox_page.structure: 3-pane professional workspace layout (Conversation List, Active Chat Thread, Customer AI Intelligence Panel).
inbox_page.left_pane: Conversation feed with channel tabs (All, Telegram, Facebook Messenger), search bar, unread badges, channel badges (Telegram sky pill, Messenger blue pill), timestamp, and active status indicators.
inbox_page.center_pane: Chat Thread with channel banner, clear speech bubbles (AI response in indigo tinted container with AI indicator pill, customer response in primary blue bubble), Khmer voice note visualizer waveform, embedded product recommendations with photo + price in KHR/USD + 'Send to Chat' button, and Bakong KHQR instant request card.
inbox_page.right_pane: Customer AI Summary Panel with intent score gauge, purchase stage pipeline pill (Inquiry -> Product Selection -> Payment Pending -> Completed), next action suggestion, fast Khmer/English quick-reply buttons, and Human Takeover toggle switch.

products_page.layout: High-density e-commerce catalog grid. Features top summary cards (Total Products, Active Catalog, Out of Stock), search and category filter bar, 'Add Product' primary CTA, and rich product cards with image preview, Khmer/English title, USD/KHR dual pricing, stock status pill, and action menu. Preserves all data-testids.

orders_page.layout: Order Operations Dashboard featuring 3 KPI metric cards (Total Revenue USD/KHR, KHQR Paid Orders, Pending Payments), tab filters (All, Paid, Pending, Expired), structured table with bold monospace Order IDs, customer details, channel tags, total amount, status badges (Paid - Emerald, Pending - Amber, Expired - Slate), and KHQR Invoice preview modal. Preserves all data-testids.

sections: Notion Knowledge Base Integration (API Key input, database selector, live sync status badge)
Bakong KHQR Payment Gateway Setup (Merchant Account ID, Merchant Name, Auto-generate KHQR toggle)
VoxCPM2 Khmer Voice Cloning System (Voice note recorder/uploader, pitch & speed controls, live audio waveform preview)
AI Behavior & Escalation Rules (Confidence thresholds, auto-product suggestion toggle, human agent handover rules)

cards: Telegram Bot Channel (Active state: Bot Token input, Webhook status indicator, Test Connection button, Live status indicator)
Facebook Messenger Channel (Locked State: Clearly marked as 'Coming Soon' to Cambodian shops pending Meta App Review & approval, disabled token fields, informational banner, 'Notify Me' action)

sections: Current Plan Card: Displays plan name (Starter, Pro, Business or Trial), active status badge, monthly AI auto-reply usage bar with visual percentage indicator, and subscription renewal date.

Pricing Tier Grid: 3 distinct plan cards (Starter $10/mo - 1,000 replies, Pro $25/mo - 5,000 replies [Most Popular], Business $59/mo - Unlimited replies) with feature checklists and 'Upgrade with KHQR' action buttons.

Bakong KHQR Pay Modal: Interactive payment dialog with red KHQR header, high-contrast QR code image, live 15-minute countdown timer, exact KHR amount, merchant name, and auto-verification status indicator.
Invoice History Table: Table showing past KHQR billing transactions with date, invoice ID, plan name, amount in USD/KHR, and downloadable receipt link.

admin_businesses_page.layout: Superadmin Tenant Management Directory. Table listing registered Cambodian merchant accounts, bot status toggles, monthly message volumes, connected channels, current subscription tier, and quick edit actions. Preserves all data-testids.

components_and_styles.buttons: Primary buttons: `btn-brand font-medium rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2`. Secondary buttons: `border border-border bg-card hover:bg-muted text-foreground rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors`.
components_and_styles.cards: Subtle border `border border-border bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-2xl shadow-sm p-5 hover:border-border/80 transition-all`.
components_and_styles.tables: Clean header with uppercase tracking-wider text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground, hoverable row styling (`hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors`), crisp bottom borders (`border-b border-border/60`).

general_ui_ux_guidelines: CRITICAL REQUIREMENT: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, navigation links, tabs, dialog triggers, toggle switches, filter buttons) MUST preserve exact existing `data-testid` attributes without omission.
Facebook Messenger channel MUST display as 'Coming soon' to shops with clear Meta review lock status.
Maintain the signature Replyflow AI brand identity (blue to indigo to violet gradient) across buttons, active state indicators, and hero brand marks.
Support both Light and Dark mode flawlessly with high APCA contrast ratios and smooth CSS transitions.
Ensure 100% responsive design across all screen sizes (mobile 390px to desktop 1920px).
Khmer script typography must render with Noto Sans Khmer for clear legibility.
instructions_to_main_agent: Apply whole dashboard professional design pass by refining utility classes and CSS design tokens in index.css and component files.
Do NOT remove or rename any data-testid attribute.
Ensure Facebook Messenger card on Channels page shows 'Coming soon' badge.
Keep all existing backend API calls, state hooks, and functionality intact.
